title: 第15章 反正我无所谓无所谓我无所谓第16章 哎呀这不巧了吗
slug: 我被系统坑成了造物主
content_zh:
姜云天给青鸳发信息道“我接到青瑶长老了！”
青鸳回复“还有五个时辰，宗门太上长老就到了，你自己把握。”
姜云天道“把握什么？”
青鸳“小色胚，你自己想。”
姜云天看了一眼青瑶。
青瑶那里他看不出有任何的表示。
青鸳又给青瑶发信息道：“这是个好机会，没有人暗中探查，你要把握好此次机会。”
青瑶“我有点不适应，要不下次？”
青鸳“下次还有这样的机会？你不怕下次有观摩团？”
青瑶银牙一咬“好！”
青鸳“那小畜生玩的可花了，你别想那么多，不就是皮囊，就当碰到妖兽。
等两三个时辰过去，你就修为恢得、神魂修复，面容恢复了。”
青瑶看完信息，也是一懵心道“这是你这个姨母应该说的话？这小畜生是骂人的吧，怎么从你嘴里说出来怎么像夸人的？”
想到青鸳说的修为恢复，神魂修复、面容恢复。
心下一横，豁出去了，回复道“等我的好消息。”
青鸳心里嗔道“哎，便宜了小畜生了，回来让他补偿，”
但心里却是甜的。
青瑶对着姜云天道“青鸳长老和你说过了吧，我们现在开始修练吧，时间紧迫，速战速决！
！”
姜云天微微一笑心道“还速战速决，我是那样的人？我从来没见过这么急切的。”

抬手一个五行剑阵，将二人笼罩，虽然外面有防护大阵，总觉得自己打个结界，才放心。
看着青石地面，青瑶脸一红，心说“在这？”
姜云天顺着青瑶眼光看着青石地面，心下也是有些汗然，这也太不讲究了吧！
于是问小狸“这里有卧室吗？”
小狸前瓜一指，姜云天和青瑶走了过去，虽然卧室内被自爆和天雷炸得七零八落，但那一张三人躺着都富裕的大床，一看就是质地非凡，不是凡品，姜云天想道，一会打包带走，这床扛造，比家里那个吱吱嘎嘎响的好太多了。
姜云天摸了摸小狸，说道“你先出去一会，我有重要的事情要做！”
小狸也不气恼，迈着猫步走出门外。
青瑶素手一挥，一道遮蔽法阵挡在那破碎的门上。
却在此时，小狸转身回来了，她就站在门外，一双水灵灵的大眼睛，向里面看着，那遮蔽的阵法，对于她来说，可以说是没有一点障碍。
扭捏半天，姜云天示意一起打坐，青瑶身子动了几次，就是不上来打坐，一柱香时间过去，姜云天心道，“你要闹哪样？”
看着时光流逝，姜云天心中急道“春霄一刻值千金，干嘛呢？这是？”
姜云天就去拉青瑶的手，刚一上手，青瑶全身就是一抖。
姜云天一阵无语，这还能不能行了！
content_en:
Jiang Yuntian sent a message to Qingyuan: "I have received the message from Elder Qingyao!"
Qingyuan replied, "There are still five hours left. The sect's supreme elder will be here. It's up to you."
Jiang Yuntian said, "What are you sure about?"
Qingyuan: "Little color embryo, you think about it yourself."
Jiang Yuntian glanced at Qingyao.
He couldn't see any indication from Qingyao.
Qingyuan sent another message to Qingyao: "This is a good opportunity. No one is spying secretly. You must seize this opportunity."
Qingyao: "I'm a little uncomfortable with it. How about next time?"
Qing Yuan: "Will there be such an opportunity next time? Are you afraid that there will be an observation group next time?"
Qingyao bit her silver teeth and said "Okay!"
Qing Yuan: "That little beast is very playful. Don't think too much. If it's not just a skin, it's like meeting a monster."
After two or three hours have passed, your cultivation will be restored, your soul will be repaired, and your appearance will be restored. "
After Qingyao read the message, she was confused and said, "Is this what an aunt like you should say? This little beast is meant to curse, why does it sound like a compliment when it comes out of your mouth?"
Thinking of what Qingyuan said about the restoration of cultivation, the restoration of the soul, and the restoration of the face.
My heart skipped a beat, I risked my life, and replied, "Wait for my good news."
Qingyuan said angrily in his heart, "Hey, the little beast got an advantage, come back and let him make up for it."
But my heart is sweet.
Qingyao said to Jiang Yuntian, "Elder Qingyuan has told you, let's start training now. Time is running out and we must fight quickly!"
! "
Jiang Yuntian smiled slightly and said, "I want to fight quickly. Who am I? I have never seen anyone so eager."
Raising his hand, he formed a five-element sword formation and enveloped the two of them. Although there was a large protective formation outside, he still felt at ease because he had created a barrier.
Looking at the bluestone ground, Qingyao blushed and thought to herself, "Here?"
Jiang Yuntian followed Qing Yao's eyes and looked at the bluestone ground, feeling a little sweaty in his heart. This is too rude!
So he asked Xiaoli, "Is there a bedroom here?"
Xiao Li pointed his finger forward, and Jiang Yuntian and Qing Yao walked over. Although the bedroom was torn apart by self-explosion and thunder, the big bed that three people could sleep on was of extraordinary quality, not ordinary. Jiang Yuntian thought, and would pack it up and take it away. This bed was made much better than the creaky bed at home.
Jiang Yuntian touched the little raccoon and said, "You go out for a while, I have important things to do!"
Xiao Li was not angry and walked out of the door with cat steps.
Qing Yaosu waved her hand, and a shielding circle blocked the broken door.
But at this moment, Xiao Li turned around and came back. She was standing outside the door, looking inside with a pair of big watery eyes. The shielding formation could be said to be no obstacle to her.
After twisting and turning for a long time, Jiang Yuntian motioned for them to meditate together. Qingyao moved a few times but refused to come up to meditate. When the time for a stick of incense passed, Jiang Yuntian thought to himself, "What kind of trouble are you going to make?"
Watching the passage of time, Jiang Yuntian said anxiously, "A moment in Chunxiao is worth a thousand pieces of gold. What are you doing? Is this?"
Jiang Yuntian went to take Qingyao's hand. As soon as he took hold, Qingyao's whole body trembled.
Jiang Yuntian was speechless for a while, could this still work?
